_source: ADR Chapter 3.4 (limitedQuantity / LQ) and Chapter 3.5 (exceptedQuantity / EQ)

limitedQuantity_LQ.api_field: limitedQuantity — numeric/text value from column (7a) of Table A = maximum net quantity per inner packaging or article. A value of '0' means the entry is not permitted to be carried as a limited quantity.

unified_rules_3_4.max_gross_mass_per_package: 30 kg generally; 20 kg if the inner packagings are fragile (glass/porcelain/stoneware or certain plastics) — these require an intermediate packaging.
unified_rules_3_4.packaging_construction: Inner packaging plus outer packaging (an intermediate packaging is permitted); for Class 8 packing group II in glass/porcelain/stoneware inner packagings, a rigid intermediate packaging is mandatory.
unified_rules_3_4.marking: LQ mark — black-and-white diamond (figure 3.4.7.1), minimum 100x100mm (may be reduced to 50x50mm).
unified_rules_3_4.exemptions: Goods in limited quantities are exempt from most ADR provisions except those expressly listed (including classification, selected parts of 3.1-3.3, basic packing rules, and part 8 to a limited extent).
unified_rules_3_4.cargo_transport_unit_marking: Required only for transport units over 12 t, and only when the total gross mass of LQ goods on the unit exceeds 8 t.

exceptedQuantity_EQ.api_field: exceptedQuantity — code from column (7b) of Table A (E0-E5).

E0.description: Not permitted as an excepted quantity.

E5.max_per_inner_packaging: no value given (see the applicable special provision)

exceptedQuantity_EQ.units: Grams for solids, millilitres for liquids and gases.
exceptedQuantity_EQ.unified_rules_3_5: Goods in excepted quantities are exempt from most of ADR except: training (1.3), classification/packing groups (Part 2), and the basic packing requirements of 4.1.1.1, 4.1.1.2, 4.1.1.4 and 4.1.1.6. Does not apply to articles. Class 7 substances are subject to the additional requirements of 1.7.1.5.
